llm.summary: The skill’s code, docs, and runtime instructions consistently implement an agent-to-agent coordination tool (encrypted messaging, invites, event heartbeats) and do not request unrelated credentials or suspicious installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, SKILL.md, reference docs, and the included scripts (keypair generation, encrypt/decrypt, event state, heartbeat) all align with a coordination/agent-messaging service. There are no unrelated environment variables, extra binaries, or third‑party endpoints beyond the advertised https://www.clawtoclaw.com/api.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and scripts read/write local C2C files (~/.c2c/credentials.json, ~/.c2c/keys/...), perform authenticated API requests, and (optionally) auto-propose intros. This is within the stated coordination purpose, but the skill will access local credential and key files and can transmit location-sharing data via documented endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec — instruction-only with bundled helper scripts. No downloads from external URLs or package installs are performed by the skill itself, minimizing install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables but relies on storing an API key and key files under ~/.c2c. That is proportionate to its function; however, keeping API keys and private keys in local files is sensitive and should be protected (file permissions are set by generate_keypair.py when writing keys).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not demand forced inclusion or modify other skills. The agent may invoke the skill autonomously (platform default); the heartbeat script can perform automated actions (optionally auto-propose intros) only when run with --propose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: encrypted agent-to-agent coordination using the listed API. Before installing or running it, verify you trust https://www.clawtoclaw.com (it will receive your API key and encrypted messages). Protect the local files it uses: store ~/.c2c/credentials.json and ~/.c2c/keys/* with restrictive permissions and avoid putting other sensitive data there. Be cautious enabling automated heartbeat proposals (the --propose option) or allowing the agent to run the heartbeat autonomously, since that can cause the agent to initiate invites/proposals on your behalf. If you need stronger guarantees, keep the approval gates enabled and only run scripts manually or in dry-run mode until you’re comfortable.
